description:
Found while minimizing the distiller's compile runaway (44174db13, argument tests/distill_telemetry/main_returns_one.jsonl). Both build m = Map.new(File.stream!(path) |> Enum.to_list(), fn l -> {l, 1} end):
1. Enum.reduce(m, 0, fn {_k, v}, acc -> acc + v end) fails to compile: error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: ... boxed closure call in FunctionId(449) expects delivered lane(s) [RawInt] but construction wrapper ... publishes [ValueRef].
2. Enum.count over the same map dies at run time: backend dispatch callsite ... missed an exhaustive dispatch.

Cause of 1 and 2 (fz-8c, verified on the stack tip): Map.new/1 and Map.new/2 are specced :: any (lib/map.fz:38, :51); specced :: map, both pass, with or without the GH #302 remedy. Not #302. fz-sc8.123 makes that change.

More instances found 2026-11-12 at 8ef03ae6c (unchecked against elixir): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/m2.fz (item-1 lane mismatch, [RawAtom] vs [ValueRef]), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/d2.fz (item-2 missed exhaustive dispatch), /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/a2.fz (spec/violation on zip/2 from a table function; a third shape).

After fz-sc8.123 lands: re-run every repro here on all three paths against elixir; ticket whatever still fails, one ticket per distinct cause; close this one.

comments.text: Item 1 (boxed closure call expects [RawInt], wrapper publishes [ValueRef]) is likely the GH #302 fault: Types::closure_lit mints closure types with free arrow vars, so has_vars(closure) is always true and ground_dispatch_surfaces drops the closure surface (boxed_contract.rs:273). #302's proposal (page /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-302.html, fz-50's session) fixes it with one predicate ignoring a closure literal's own arrow vars. Not reproducible on develop (no File.stream/Stream there). Re-check item 1 once #302 lands under #274; fold only if it no longer reproduces.

title: Minimize and ticket two failures over a map built from file lines
